# OpenBento Dashboard - AI/LLM Information

## About
OpenBento Dashboard is a customizable bento-style mission control interface for monitoring multiple live video streams from YouTube, Twitch, and Kick platforms.

## Key Features
- 12-column magnetic grid layout with 6 rows
- Drag-to-resize widgets that snap to grid cells
- YouTube, Twitch, and Kick live stream integration
- Self-healing stream recovery system
- Custom widget colors and themes
- Dark and light mode support
- Firebase authentication with Google Sign-In

## Technical Details
- Built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
- Uses @dnd-kit for drag-and-drop functionality
- PostgreSQL database for stream status caching
- YouTube Data API v3 for stream healing
- Real-time pulse cache checking stream health every 5 minutes

## Use Cases
- Multi-stream monitoring for content creators
- News feed aggregation dashboard
- Live event monitoring
- Personal mission control for favorite channels

## API Endpoints
- GET /api/links - Get available stream channels
- GET /api/streams/status - Get global stream health status
- POST /api/streams/heal - Trigger stream healing for broken videos
